title: The Nick
venue_description:
The Nick - Birmingham's Iconic Rock Dive & Open Mic Haven

The Nick is a legendary Birmingham venue known for its gritty, no-frills rock atmosphere and long history of supporting local music. It serves as a proving ground for bands and musicians with a welcoming open mic scene.

Live Music and Events

Weekly open mics (Birmingham Bandstand) feature a mix of acoustic, full bands, and all genres. Backline often provided. Hosts and sound engineers support performers.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Classic dive bar vibe with late hours, full bar, and dedicated music crowd. A Birmingham institution for decades.

title: Dobber's 5 Points Pub
venue_description:
Dobber's 5 Points Pub - Neighborhood Music Spot

A friendly 5 Points pub popular for its weekly open mic and jam sessions in a casual, community-oriented setting.

Live Music and Events

Tuesday open mic with sign-up around 5:30 PM, followed by live music jams. Welcoming to musicians of all levels.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Pet-friendly, full bar, good food, and a relaxed neighborhood vibe perfect for local talent.
